core_connection.text: Audible is a subscription service Mia has used. She writes to its customer service to cancel her Premium Plus membership and get refunds for charges she did not use.

evidence.quote: cancel my Audible Premium Plus membership
cancel the membership and refund the $14.95 charge
Hello Audible Customer Service,
Hello Audible Customer Service,
Thank you,
Thank you,
Thank you,
I would like to cancel my Audible
Thank you for refunding the March charge
I have not used the new credit
Yes, please go ahead with the refund.

facts.text: Mia's plan was Audible Premium Plus. It renewed every month at $14.95 starting in November 2024.

evidence.quote: renewed at $14.95 per month since November 2024

facts.text: Mia had not downloaded or listened to any title since October 2024. In March 2025 she asked to cancel and get back five unused charges totaling $74.75.

evidence.quote: The five charges total $74.75.

facts.text: Audible refunded only the March 2025 charge of $14.95. Mia then asked for the other four charges, $59.80 for November 2024 through February 2025, to be reviewed.

evidence.quote: Thank you for refunding the March charge of $14.95.
which total $59.80

facts.text: Mia wants refunds to go back to the original payment method, not to stay as account credits. She also wants unused credits removed.

evidence.quote: to the original payment method rather than account credits
The credits can be removed from my account.

facts.text: On November 8, 2025, Mia paused her membership and set it to cancel when the pause ended on February 8, 2026.

evidence.quote: When I paused my membership on November 8, 2025

facts.text: The membership renewed anyway on February 8, 2026, and Mia was charged $14.95. She asked Audible to cancel and refund it.

evidence.quote: it was renewed on February 8, 2026 and I was charged $14.95

facts.text: On February 12, 2026, Mia confirmed that Audible should go ahead with the $14.95 refund.

evidence.quote: Yes, please go ahead with the refund.

facts.text: Mia usually asks Audible to confirm the cancellation, the refund amount, and that no further charges will be made.

evidence.quote: Please confirm the cancellation
no further charges will be made

facts.text: Mia adds her account email at the end of her follow-up emails.

evidence.quote: account email: [EMAIL]
account email: [EMAIL]
